pages: TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS O4 Series Oil Furnaces Lowboy Highboy/Horizontal Downﬂow/Horizontal The O4 Series Oil Furnace combines time proven design in the Classic Low Boy, High Boy, and Downﬂow conﬁgurations. The High Boy and Downﬂow models can be conﬁgured for horizontal applications. The units are multi-ﬁred for a wide range of outputs (.50 to 2.0 G.P.H. depending on model). Classic design, versatility and reliability are important attributes that oil heat professionals have come to rely upon. Low Boy High Boy/Horizontal FEATURES and BENEFITS s #ABINET #ONSTRUCTION – 22 gauge steel cabinet ensures strength and quiet operation. s &INISH – Thermoset powder coat for greater durability. s &IRING 2ATES – Multi-ﬁring rates for a wide range of applications. s "URNER – Equipped with industry leading Beckett burner which includes cleancut pump, PSC motor, and solid state controls. Factory pre-wired, pre-assembled and tested. Ready to connect to fuel supply line. Downﬂow/Horizontal shown with optional front vestibule s "AROMETRIC $RAFT #ONTROL – Included with all models. s (EAT %XCHANGER – Proven heat exchanger design featuring 100% welded construction for maximum performance. Large, accessible heat exchanger clean-out ports. s 2ADIATOR – “Wrap-around” type for maximum heat transfer. s Blower – Direct drive type. Permanently lubricated, resilient mounted except O4LD-231A which is belt drive. s Blower Motor – Designed for heavy-duty, continuous operation. Thermally protected. Four-speed is standard. O4LD-231A uses a single speed motor. A pulley change is required to change speeds. s "LOWER !SSEMBLY – Entire unit with motor can be easily removed for servicing. s &ILTERS )NCLUDED IN ALL -ODELS – Filter and rack built in on O4LD models. Filter and rack packaged with O4HD and O4MD models. s )NSULATION – Spun glass and aluminum foil for “hand cool” cabinet. s !CCESS $OOR – Easily removed for access to burner and controls. Completely enclosed controls and burner in most units. s !IR #ONDITIONING – Pre-wired fan center relay is standard on all models except O4LD-231A. Note: All oil ﬁred furnaces manufactured after May 1, 2005 FOR SALE IN #ANADA require additional safety devices that will shut down the Oil Burner if the Flue Vent becomes blocked.
